description: As a booking agent, I want to enter passenger details in a dedicated step of the booking form so that I can capture all required traveller information before proceeding to payment.

acs.text: The passenger details step displays fields: Title (dropdown), First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Passport Number, and Nationality.
Title dropdown options are: Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr, Other.
All fields are mandatory. The Next button is disabled until all fields are filled.
Passport Number must be 6–9 alphanumeric characters. An inline error appears if the format is invalid.

sections.content: The step indicator at the top shows: Step 1 - Flight, Step 2 - Passengers (current), Step 3 - Payment. The Next button is positioned bottom-right of the form.
